# Punkolink

> A cloud platform of equal building blocks — managed databases and search, an L7 router, and a place to run any container — assembled into a stack. Services run on DRP (Docker Run Platform), billed per minute in credits. When something breaks, the engineers who built the platform step in. Priced simply: credits at $1 each, 20 free to start, no card.

## Platform

- [Managed containers and services](https://punkolink.com/saas.html): Managed Postgres, Redis, Meilisearch, and Qdrant, plus the L7 router and DRP — equal building blocks, not a hosting plan. Provisioned in minutes; run yourself or grow into a watched core.
- [L7 router](https://punkolink.com/l7.html): A layer-7 router for the core of a network — load balancing, redundancy, rate limiting, bot and brute-force protection, layer-3 and layer-7 access control, monitoring, and a web GUI. Available as a managed service or run on your own infrastructure.
- [DRP (Docker Run Platform)](https://punkolink.com/saas.html): Punkolink's system for running any container. The unit of billing is a DRP container, priced the same regardless of contents — a Punkolink image, an open-source image, or a customer-supplied one. Also available on its own, as an empty container the customer fills.

## Solutions (engineering services)

- [Solutions](https://punkolink.com/service.html): Concrete engineering work around the router — deployment, incident response, readiness upkeep, degradation monitoring, infrastructure and software work, peak-load preparation, abuse protection, access management, cost audit, and on-prem delivery. Scoped and priced per engagement; engaged one at a time as a system needs them.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://punkolink.com/pricing.html): One thing to buy — credits, priced at $1 each, sold in packs of 5. 20 free credits on signup, no card. Credits are spent as services run; a DRP instance costs about 5 credits per month.
- [Pricing Policy](https://punkolink.com/legal/pricing-policy.html): The exact terms — a credit is a unit of account and prepayment for services, not a payment instrument, not e-money, not withdrawable. Per-minute rates, including the exact DRP rate, are set out here.

- [Console](https://cloud.punkolink.com): Create an account, claim 20 free credits, and spin up a container. No card required.
